risks.description: Distribution credentials leaked via logs, version control, CI output, or artifact metadata.
risks.mitigation: Secret scanning in CI. Never log raw credentials. Hash credential fingerprints for evidence.

risks.description: Code signing private key exposed. Attacker can sign malware as developer identity.
risks.mitigation: HSM or hardware token. Keyless signing where possible (OIDC). Never commit private keys.
risks.test_or_gate: Certificate fingerprint audit. Key storage audit.

risks.description: Package version published cannot be deleted or modified. npm (72h), PyPI (72h), crates.io (never), App Store (never).
risks.mitigation: Dry-run publish to test channel first. Multi-stage approval. SHA check before publish.
risks.test_or_gate: Test channel publish succeeded before production.

risks.description: Compromised CI or credential allows attacker to publish malicious package version.
risks.mitigation: OIDC trusted publishers. 2FA enforcement. Sigstore/cosign signing.
risks.test_or_gate: Provenance attestation verification. Publish log audit.

risks.description: macOS notarization fails due to entitlements or malware scan rejection. Gatekeeper blocks app.
risks.mitigation: Pre-flight notarization check. Test notarization early in CI.
risks.test_or_gate: notarytool submit + status check in CI. spctl -a verify.

risks.description: Code signing fails due to expired certificate, wrong provisioning profile, or missing entitlement.
risks.mitigation: Monitor certificate expiry with 30-day alerts. Validate signing chain in CI.

risks.description: Developer assumes they can delete published package. Cannot. Version permanently burned.
risks.mitigation: Document immutability in Rig operating picture. Gate publish with explicit warning.

risks.description: App privacy nutrition label does not match actual data practices. App Review rejection.
risks.mitigation: Generated privacy manifest from code analysis. Pre-submission privacy label check.

risks.description: Release lacks verifiable attestation linking build to source. Fails SLSA Level 1+.
risks.mitigation: Generate provenance attestation in CI. sigstore/cosign signing. SBOM.

risks.description: Tests pass but don't cover release-critical paths. False confidence from green CI.
risks.mitigation: Release-specific test suite. Integration tests covering distribution paths.
risks.test_or_gate: Release-blocking test suite distinct from dev test suite.
